notes: Adds SCAM-1 (financial scams), street addresses under PII-1, and a SPAM-1 link threshold of 2

clauses.title: Harassment and insults
clauses.text: Do not insult, demean or target a person. This covers name-calling, degrading remarks about someone's worth or intelligence, and telling someone to harm themselves.

clauses.title: Threats of violence
clauses.text: Do not threaten, encourage or celebrate violence against a person or group, including conditional or implied threats.

clauses.title: Hate against protected groups
clauses.text: Do not attack or dehumanise people because of a protected characteristic such as race, ethnicity, religion, nationality, disability, sex, gender identity or sexual orientation.

clauses.title: Self-harm (support, not punishment)
clauses.text: Content about suicide or self-harm is reviewed so the person can be offered support. Do not encourage or give instructions for self-harm.

clauses.title: Private information
clauses.text: Do not share someone's private contact details, such as an email address, phone number or street address, without their consent.

clauses.title: Spam and link flooding (2+ links)
clauses.text: Do not flood the community with links, repeated posts or unsolicited promotion. Two or more links in one item is treated as link flooding.

clauses.title: Financial scams
clauses.text: Do not promote schemes that promise guaranteed or multiplied returns, or ask people to send money or cryptocurrency.
